system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you would cast a Jutsu that would grant you DR (Damage Reduction) or Temporary hit points, you can spend a superiority die. When you do, the first instance of damage your Temporary hit points, or your Damage reduction would interact with this turn is echoed outward affecting all hostile creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you. Affected creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw against the original DC of the Attack or Jutsu (If Weapon/Unarmed, Taijutsu save DC). On a failed save they take the same damage inflicted from the attack or jutsu + the result of your Superiority die. On a successful save they take half.
